image_description: A white and black airship (dirigible) floating in a clear blue sky. The airship has an elongated, cigar-shaped envelope with 'THE AIRSHIP' text written on the side in a stylized font. It features a red vertical stabilizer at the tail and dark horizontal fins. A small gondola structure is visible suspended beneath the forward-mid section of the hull.

The horizontal stabilizers at the tail lack clear geometric definition. They appear to melt slightly into the hull or fade out, rather than being distinct rigid structures attached to the tail cone.

The details on the gondola and the connection points to the hull are vague and 'smudged'. There is a lack of mechanical precision expected in engine mounts or suspension cables, appearing more like painted blobs than physical parts.
